Treatments

Salon Party

A relaxed salon experience with the people you like most, at your home or at Maison Coiffure.

Invite Maison Coiffure into your home for a relaxed salon experience with friends or family. A gathering can include haircuts, styling, nourishing hair treatments, WellaPlex and Indian Head Massage, with hair analysis, home-care advice and styling tips tailored to the group. It suits birthdays, life transitions, bridal showers or simply a shared evening of care.

As the host you provide the setting, drinks and snacks; Maison Coiffure brings a washbasin, towels and products, and the group chooses a focus beforehand. Colour work on location requires a prior consultation, so the appropriate products can be prepared.

Two ways to gather

At your home. The salon comes to you, and the evening stays entirely yours.

At Maison Coiffure. Come to the salon as a group and let the home-salon calm do its work.

Both are enquiry preferences rather than promises of availability: tell us your preferred location, date, group size and the treatments you are interested in, and we will prepare a personal quote for your gathering.

Request a salon party quote

A submitted request is a quote enquiry, not a confirmed appointment. Maison Coiffure will contact you to discuss the programme, timing and price. Submitting opens WhatsApp with your details ready to send; nothing is sent until you send it yourself.
